tools.name: goal.delete
tools.description: SOFT-ARCHIVE a Goal version (write). This is NOT a hard delete: Goals are immutable, lineage-versioned rows, so the row is never removed — the version is moved to the 'Archiviert' workflow state through the WorkflowEngine (the same gated path as goal.transition). The row stays readable via goal.read and goal.list_versions, and goal.query still returns it when include_archived=true. REACHABLE FROM: any state the workspace's Goal workflow defines a transition to 'Archiviert' from — with the stock 'goal_default' preset that is 'Entwurf' and 'Freigegeben' (both approver/admin only). A workspace whose Goal workflow was customised, or that was provisioned before the 'Entwurf -> Archiviert' edge existed, may only allow it from 'Freigegeben'. ON AN INVALID STATE: returns VALIDATION_ERROR (JSON-RPC error, HTTP 400) naming the current state; call goal.transition with an unreachable target to get the list of states that ARE reachable in the error details. A caller lacking the approver/admin role gets PERMISSION_DENIED. REVERSIBLE via goal.reactivate (or goal.transition back to 'Entwurf'). Alias: goal.outdate.

tools.name: goal.list_versions
tools.description: List all versions in a Goal lineage, oldest first.

tools.name: goal.outdate
tools.description: Soft-delete a Goal version (write). Exact alias of goal.delete, named after the {entity}.outdate convention the other artifact namespaces use — for Goals the soft-delete state is the workflow's 'Archiviert', not the generic 'outdated' escape hatch, because 'outdated' is foreign to the Goal state machine and would hide the row from the archive filters. See goal.delete for the reachable source states and error behaviour.

tools.name: goal.query
tools.description: List the current version of every Goal lineage in a workspace (read-only). By default omits lineages whose current version is 'Archiviert'; set include_archived to list those too.

include_archived.description: If true, include lineages whose current version is 'Archiviert'. Defaults to false.

tools.name: goal.reactivate
tools.description: Restore an archived Goal version (write). Transitions it back to the Goal workflow's initial state ('Entwurf' by default) through the same gated path as goal.transition. Deliberately does NOT restore the pre-archive state: only 'Freigegeben' versions feed MainGoal aggregation, so a restored Goal returns as a draft and must be approved again. The stock preset gates 'Archiviert -> Entwurf' on approver/admin and requires a reason (defaulted to 'reactivated' when none is given).

tools.name: goal.read
tools.description: Read a single Goal version by id.

tools.name: goal.transition
tools.description: Transition a Goal version's workflow state (e.g. Entwurf -> Freigegeben). Only Freigegeben versions feed MainGoal aggregation.

target_state.description: Target workflow state. These are the ``goal_default`` preset's states; a workspace with a customised Goal workflow may accept further states.

change_reason.description: Reason for the change. Required by the Entwurf -> Freigegeben transition.

tools.name: goal.update
tools.description: Update a Goal (write). Goals are immutable, lineage-versioned rows, so this does NOT edit the addressed row: it appends a new version to the same lineage carrying the given fields, starting again at 'Entwurf'. Omitted fields are inherited from the addressed version (PATCH semantics). Identical in effect to goal.create_version, but addressed by goal_id instead of lineage_id. 'status' cannot be changed here — use goal.transition.

goal_id.description: UUID of the Goal version to base the new version on (not the lineage_id).

data.description: Fields to update. `status` is READ-ONLY (REQ-143) and ignored if present — the WorkflowEngine owns the lifecycle state; use the transitions endpoint instead.

change_reason.description: Reason for the change. Required when the workspace's change_reason preset policy is 'mandatory' (e.g. extended preset).

tools.name: requirement.validate
tools.description: AI validation of a requirement.

tools.name: review.approve
tools.description: Approve an item currently awaiting review: transitions it to its preset's auto_approve_target state (falls back to the first available approver/admin-gated transition's target -- excluding reject/outdated-equivalent states -- if no explicit auto_approve_target is configured).

tools.name: review.list_pending
tools.description: List items in a workspace whose current workflow state is one hop away from a human approval gate (a transition whose allowed_roles excludes 'editor').

workspace_id.description: Workspace to scope the search to.

tools.name: review.reject
tools.description: Reject an item currently awaiting review: transitions it to the universal 'outdated' state (Phase 0), recording reason in the workflow history.

tools.name: review.request_changes
tools.description: Send an item currently awaiting review back to its workflow's initial state for rework, recording reason in the workflow history.

title.description: Required. 'title' as validated by the risk service.

probability.description: Required. 'probability' as validated by the risk service.

impact.description: Required. 'impact' as validated by the risk service.

description.description: Optional. 'description' as accepted by the risk service.

category.description: Optional. 'category' as accepted by the risk service.

owner.description: Optional. 'owner' as accepted by the risk service.

mitigation_strategy.description: Optional. 'mitigation_strategy' as accepted by the risk service.

status.description: Optional. 'status' as accepted by the risk service.

uid.description: Optional. 'uid' as accepted by the risk service.

detection.description: Optional. 'detection' as accepted by the risk service.

owner_user_id.description: Optional. 'owner_user_id' as accepted by the risk service.

tools.name: risk.delete
tools.description: Delete a risk entity (write).

tools.name: risk.outdate
tools.description: Soft-delete a risk entity via the workflow engine's outdate escape hatch (write).

tools.name: risk.query
tools.description: List risk entities in a workspace (read-only).

include_outdated.description: If true, include outdated (soft-deleted) entities. Defaults to false.

tools.name: risk.reactivate

title.description: Optional. 'title' as accepted by the risk service.

description.description: Optional. 'description' as accepted by the risk service.

probability.description: Optional. 'probability' as accepted by the risk service.

impact.description: Optional. 'impact' as accepted by the risk service.

category.description: Optional. 'category' as accepted by the risk service.

owner.description: Optional. 'owner' as accepted by the risk service.

mitigation_strategy.description: Optional. 'mitigation_strategy' as accepted by the risk service.

change_reason.description: Optional. 'change_reason' as accepted by the risk service.

detection.description: Optional. 'detection' as accepted by the risk service.

owner_user_id.description: Optional. 'owner_user_id' as accepted by the risk service.

tools.name: test.create
tools.description: Create a TestCase, optionally auto-linked to a requirement (write, audited).

linked_req_id.description: Optional requirement UUID to create a 'verifies' TraceLink.

tools.name: test.derive_from_requirement
tools.description: SysEng 2.0 N5: propose a TestCase draft (title, description, steps) for a Requirement via the LLM adapter. mode='preview' (default) returns the draft only; mode='write' persists it as a TestCase and links it back to the requirement via a 'verifies' trace link.

mode.description: 'preview' (default) returns drafts only; 'write' persists them and creates the corresponding trace link(s).

policy.description: Only relevant for mode='write'. 'manual' (default) leaves new entities in their initial draft state; 'auto' best-effort auto-advances them through their workflow.

tools.name: test.get
tools.description: Fetch a single TestCase by ID.

tools.name: test.link
tools.description: Create a 'verifies' TraceLink between a TestCase and a Requirement (write, audited).

tools.name: test.outdate
tools.description: Soft-delete a TestCase via the workflow engine's outdate escape hatch (write).

tools.name: test.query
tools.description: List TestCases in a workspace.

include_outdated.description: If true, include outdated (soft-deleted) test cases. Defaults to false.

tools.name: test.reactivate
tools.description: Restore an outdated TestCase to its previous state (write).

tools.name: test.run_create
tools.description: Create a TestRun (write, audited).

test_case_ids.description: Optional list of test case UUIDs to include.

tools.name: test.run_get
tools.description: Fetch a TestRun with its results by ID.

tools.name: test.run_report_results
tools.description: Add result(s) to a TestRun (write, audited).

results.description: List of result entries. A single result object (not wrapped in an array) is also accepted.

tools.name: test.update
tools.description: Update TestCase fields including execution_status (write, audited).

data.description: Fields to update (title, description, steps, status).

tools.name: traceability.create_link
tools.description: Create a TraceLink between two artifacts/entities (write, audited). Generic counterpart to architecture.link/test.link for Need->Requirement, Requirement->Requirement and any other core-entity pair (fix #121). Compatible with traceability.suggest_links output: pass a suggestion's 'source_artifact_id' as 'source_id' and a ranked candidate's 'artifact_id' as 'target_id' (both accepted as aliases) to accept that suggestion.

source_id.description: UUID of the link source (alias: source_artifact_id).

target_id.description: UUID of the link target (alias: artifact_id).

artifact_id.description: Alias for 'target_id' (matches a suggest_links ranked candidate's 'artifact_id').

tools.name: traceability.query
tools.description: Return the upstream/downstream TraceLink graph for an artifact.

tools.name: traceability.suggest_links
tools.description: SysEng 2.0 N3 (first stage): run the SE-Auditor for a workspace, filter findings that name a missing trace link (TRACE-P1/-P1b/-P2), and rank each finding's deterministic candidate pool via the LLM adapter (mock by default). Read-only/advisory — nothing is persisted; every returned finding/candidate reference is a real one from this run. No pgvector/embedding search is performed.

tools.name: user.assign_role

preset.description: Active workspace preset (gates the approver role).

tools.name: user.create
tools.description: Create a new user (admin-only, write, audited).

tools.name: user.deactivate
tools.description: Deactivate a user (is_active=False), admin-only, write, audited.

user_id.description: UUID of the user to deactivate.

tools.name: user.list
tools.description: List users, tenant-scoped (admin-only, read).

tenant_id.description: Optional tenant UUID (defaults to caller's tenant).

is_active.description: Optional active-state filter; omit to return both.

tools.name: workspace.close
tools.description: Soft-delete a workspace (is_active=False), admin-only, audited.

workspace_id.description: UUID of the workspace to close.

tools.name: workspace.delete
tools.description: Hard-delete a workspace with captcha confirmation, admin-only, audited.

workspace_id.description: UUID of the workspace to delete.

confirmation_text.description: Must equal the workspace name (case-sensitive captcha).

tools.name: workspace.get_context
tools.description: Return a workspace status summary for agent orientation. Response: result.workspace_context = {tenant_id, user_id, active_roles (roles resolved for the calling API key), workspace_id}. If workspace_id is given, additionally: preset (active rigor preset name), preset_features (dict of enabled feature flags for the preset), change_reason_policy, terminology (dev_mode/se_mode label profile), and open_requirements_count (Requirements with status != 'approved' in the workspace). ``depth`` (summary|normal|full, default summary) also adds entity counts: requirements, architecture, tests, risks. ``include_outdated`` (default false) includes outdated items in those counts. ``role`` is an optional label echoed back for prompt-shaping by the caller — it never filters the returned data.

workspace_id.description: Optional UUID of the workspace to summarise.

include_outdated.description: Include outdated items in entity counts (default false).

role.description: Optional caller role label (documentation only, never filters data).

tools.name: workspace.get_preferences
tools.description: Retrieve workspace configuration preferences (read-only).

tools.name: workspace.list
tools.description: List the workspaces visible to the caller's tenant. Response: result.workspaces = [{id, name, description}], result.count. Tenant-scoped (issue #362). Closed workspaces (is_active=false) are excluded unless include_inactive=true.

tools.name: workspace.llm_system_prompt
tools.description: Render a natural-language system prompt for AI-agent session start, built from the same entity data as ``workspace.get_context`` (active requirements, architecture elements, test coverage). Response: result.system_prompt (str). Read-only — does not persist or mutate anything. ``role`` is echoed as a text label only ("Du bist als {role} unterwegs") and never filters the underlying data.

workspace_id.description: UUID of the workspace to summarise.

role.description: Optional caller role label (documentation only, never filters data).

include_outdated.description: Include outdated items in the underlying entity data (default false).

tools.name: workspace.reactivate
tools.description: Undo a workspace close (is_active=True), admin-only, audited.

workspace_id.description: UUID of the workspace to reactivate.
